VALUE-BASED PROCUREMENT

How the NHS weighs value against whole life cost.

THE FIVE VALUE DOMAINS

Social value, efficiency, patient and staff, supply chain, purpose. The five value domains should have a minimum sum weighting of 60%, 10% of which must be allocated to the social value domain.

EVERGREEN AND TENDER ENTRY

From 6 April 2026 all suppliers submitting tenders must have achieved Evergreen Level 1 at the point of tender close.

Sources: MHRA, NICE, Find a Tender, NHS Supply Chain.
